Hello, I saw your artwork and thought it looks amazing, especially https://skeb.jp/@urasaki_SUG/works/37 .
I would like to request a drawing of my og in your art style.

[Usual Design]
* Long Blue Hair (tied to the side)
* Grey Eyes with ♦️ shape pupils 
* Very Light Skin Tone 
* 160~163 cm
* Wearing Headphones (with padding)

[Character Details/Lore]

(For better understanding.)

She reside inside the Nexus Gateway: a place that was created to be heart and the bridge connecting the worlds, a place where she can travel any place, worlds, dimensions, etc. Once belonged to the original Clock Master (whom she considered him as her Father and the other resident alongside with her), she unwillingly takes on the role of the Defender of the Gateway after his mysterious disappearance. Her loneliness grew as time passed and so does the expansion of the Nexus.

No matter how big or beautiful the place is, it could never sooth her eternal loneliness. 

[Outfit]
I wanted her to be wearing a new outfit that I tried to sketch. It is incomplete so I will leave it up to you of completing her new outfit. 
Her collar is a black choker with a silver diamond (I think there is a few images that has that reference.) She is wearing an overdress with an undershirt and black jeans/pants. I wanted her to wear long stocking and boots, but I wanted to simply the boots design, like having a buckle. I only gave a few color references since I am not sure what color to choose afterwards, so I will leave it up to you.

For the sleeves, I made it too long, it was supposed to be half of the length (I marked the actual length) and underneath it there are long black gloves.

I also wanted to tie her hair up in a side ponytail. (I put an image there for an example along with the outfit sketch.)

[Prompt] 
I wanted to be a full body drawing to show her new outfit. (I’m apologies for asking for a fully body, but I do want to see a full view of her.)

I wanted the prompt to be her in this beautiful astrology place, but she shows her loneliness. 

I don’t expect to be exact, so you can have the creativity freedom. I will leave the pose and expression up to you. I would like to ask permission to use this on SNS like Twitter, Twitch & YouTube. Is it also possible to receive a PSD with the background, character and signature separated?

Thank you very much for your consideration.
